map.示例：用 Mermaid 语法画一张判断流程图: Example: draw a decision flowchart with Mermaid syntax
map.：输入：\ngraph TD\n A[开始] --> B{条件判断}\n B:
: Input:
<graph TD
  A[Start] --> B{Condition?}
  B -->|Yes| C[Process]
  B -->|No| D[End]
The page renders in real time (500ms debounce); after confirming, click 'Export SVG / PNG' to get vector or bitmap.

map.编辑内容按图表类型分别自动保存到浏览器本地，刷新页面会恢复该类型草稿；切换图表类: Edits auto-save separately per diagram type in browser local storage, and a refresh restores that type's draft; switching types does not overwrite each other, and loading an example or clearing asks first and keeps "Restore previous". Export supports SVG (vector, editable), PNG (raster) and .mmd source.
map.切换图表类型会覆盖当前内容吗？: No. Flowchart, sequence, Gantt, class, state, ER and pie drafts are stored separately; switching back loads the last code edited for that type. Loading an example or clearing only affects the current type, asks for confirmation first, and keeps "Restore previous".
map.Tab 键会困住键盘焦点吗？: No by default. Tab indent is off, so Tab/Shift+Tab move focus normally; enable "Tab indent" to intercept Tab, and press Esc to exit. With a multi-line selection, Tab/Shift+Tab adds or removes two spaces per line and keeps the selection instead of deleting it.
map.可以导入或导出 Mermaid 源码吗？: Yes. The "Export source" button downloads the current type as an .mmd text file; "Import source" reads an .mmd/.txt file into the editor. Import asks before overwriting and keeps "Restore previous".
